message: 秋色変華

name: Synn
message: 「Breathe iiin~~~! ...Phew~~~~!」
I sit down on a bench in the courtyard and go limp.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, that's one grand deep breath.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I'd want to take a big gulp of fresh air. I never expected Sengen'in-sensei to be that strict.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's just how overeager student teachers are, ain't it?」
Looking visibly exhausted, Misa walks right past me. She doesn't seem to have noticed I'm here.

name: Synn
message: 「No wonder--Sengen'in-sensei is in charge of Misa's class, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Hisa's headin' into the wooded zone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop making her sound like a guerrilla fighter. She's just walking down the path. Taking a leisurely stroll along a tree-lined avenue really soothes the soul.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hisa had her head hangin' way down, though? Doubt she's got the headspace to look up at the trees.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Hey, Paqy, let's go cheer Misa up.」
We caught up to her easily.
Misa stands silently on the path surrounded by trees, tears welling in her eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「What could have happened to Misa... Sh-should I call out to her?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Probably no big deal, right? Bet she just argued with the student teacher and got schooled or somethin'.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you always interpret everything so maliciously?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa is twice as sensitive as anyone else. The fact that she's still bothered by the Student Council election is the clearest proof of that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Those tears are, yes... she must be looking at the trees starting to turn yellow and getting lost in thought like this.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, it's already completely autumn...」

name: Misa
message: 「Mm... *sniff*, watching the fallen leaves flutter down makes tears spill over for no reason at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「See, so typical of Misa, isn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You think so? Ria-chan's the real deal, sure, but the way I see it, Hisa's a fake rich girl.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the reason for those tears is probably somethin' like this.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yaaawn, I'm so sleepy... I stayed up late last night and finished reading a whole shoujo manga series, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, my face feels kind of itchy. Could the cured mackerel I had for a midnight snack have given me food poisoning?」

name: Misa
message: 「*Shiver, shiver, tremble, tremble*」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes!? M-Misa, when did you get right up in my face?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Z-Zzz... zzz...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun... What kind of wild delusions are you having, violating my portrait rights like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm not the only one. Paqy was--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzzzzzzzzzzz!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san is fast asleep and looking completely peaceful, isn't he?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where?! He's dripping cold sweat and faking sleep!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, I'm not particularly angry, you know? I just want to correct your mistaken interpretation and have you know the truth.」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Liar, you're furious.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just listen to my explanation! I'll admit that I yawned from lack of sleep.」

name: Misa
message: 「However, I was not absorbed in manga. I simply had no choice but to throw myself into much more creative work.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... *flinch*」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you backing away and trying to run?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My legs are moving on their own... Probably a defense mechanism.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, see ya, Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait right there! Sakura-kun, you're still laboring under a misunderstanding!」

name: Misa
message: 「What I had for my midnight snack was a teriyaki cheese hamburg steak!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doing that in the middle of the night is basically suicide, ya know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do you even realize how high-calorie teriyaki is? You're on the fast track to getting fat!」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrrrr! What did you say?! I won't forgive you for this, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, Paqy's the one who's awake!!」
Under the early autumn blue sky, I play a brief game of tag with Misa.
I'm relieved that Misa isn't feeling down.
More than that, what I should be worrying about is my own safety...
